## 7. Common Formulas

### Market Capitalization

\[
\text{Market Cap} = \text{Share Price} \times \text{Diluted Shares Outstanding}
\]

### Price / Earnings

\[
\text{P/E} = \frac{\text{Share Price}}{\text{FY2025E EPS}}
\]

### Price / Tangible Book Value

\[
\text{P/TBV} = \frac{\text{Share Price}}{\text{Tangible Book Value per Share}}
\]

### Tangible Book Value per Share

\[
\text{TBVPS} = \frac{\text{Common Equity} - \text{Goodwill} - \text{Intangibles}}{\text{Common Shares Outstanding}}
\]

### ROTCE

\[
\text{ROTCE} = \frac{\text{Net Income Available to Common}}{\text{Average Tangible Common Equity}}
\]

### Efficiency Ratio

\[
\text{Efficiency Ratio} = \frac{\text{Noninterest Expense}}{\text{Net Interest Income} + \text{Noninterest Income}}
\]

### Loan-to-Deposit Ratio

\[
\text{Loan-to-Deposit Ratio} = \frac{\text{Total Loans}}{\text{Total Deposits}}
\]

## Standard Bank Valuation Formulas

| Metric | Formula |
|---|---|
| **Market Cap** | Share price × diluted shares outstanding |
| **P / E** | Share price ÷ FY2025 EPS |
| **P / TBV** | Share price ÷ tangible book value per share |
| **P / BV** | Share price ÷ book value per share |
| **Market Cap / Assets** | Market capitalization ÷ total assets |
| **Dividend Yield** | Annual dividend per share ÷ share price |
| **ROA** | Net income ÷ average assets |
| **ROE** | Net income ÷ average common equity |
| **ROTCE** | Net income available to common shareholders ÷ average tangible common equity |
| **Net Interest Margin** | Net interest income ÷ average earning assets |
| **Efficiency Ratio** | Noninterest expense ÷ revenue |
| **Loan / Deposit Ratio** | Total loans ÷ total deposits |
| **NCO Ratio** | Net charge-offs ÷ average loans |
| **Allowance / Loans** | Allowance for credit losses ÷ total loans |
| **CET1 Ratio** | Common Equity Tier 1 capital ÷ risk-weighted assets |
